kind: Local generated PR-comment artifact; no GitHub PR was created or posted to.
scenario: Deliberately restrictive local teaching policy; not an upstream defect report.

derive_layers = false

source_roots = ["src/main/java"]
languages = ["java"]
exclude = ["**/test/**", "**/tests/**", "**/Tests/**", "**/testdata/**", "**/node_modules/**", "**/target/**", "**/build/**", "**/*_test.*", "**/*Test.*", "**/*.spec.ts"]

interpretation: The raw tool output reports prioritized findings 0 → 1 despite unchanged tracked sources. These are review candidates, not a claim of a source-code regression or a real pull request.
